verdict.rationale: Luma documents its own Luma Agents for multi-step video and image workflows that 'research, generate, and refine' across media. It also claims messy or chained natural-language prompts work natively, so the product can be driven by language. However, the evidence never shows that natural-language commands operate the product beyond generation (navigating, managing assets, configuring settings); community reports only confirm prompt-to-video generation. Missing for 10: explicit docs of natural-language command control over product operations, details of how the agent interface accepts and executes instructions, independent hands-on corroboration of Luma Agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Luma Agents for multi-step video and image workflows
Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
Messy or chained prompts work natively. No middleware or prompt engineering required.
